subject: Marketplace security packaging playbook & DPA step-in
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudcore.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging requirements for marketplace listing

Hi Sean,

We're kicking off the compliance package intake for CloudCore's GCP and AWS marketplace submissions. Our catalog team needs the security artifacts consolidated into a single package we can attach to the listing and share with co-sell partners. Specifically the reviewers asked for:

- SOC 2 Type II report (or an executive summary if full report cannot be published)
- Pen test letter or executive summary (vendor redacted is OK)
- Fully executed DPA or the draft DPA if signing will happen after acceptance
- A short one-pager describing your data retention and key management controls

Can you confirm what we can provide by next Friday (2026-07-30)? Also let us know if you require a mutual NDA or a specific DocuSign flow before we can receive fuller reports.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Partner Programs, CloudCore Systems
elena@cloudcore.com
[CloudCore Marketplace]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudcore.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging requirements for marketplace listing

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list.

Short answer: we can deliver a market-ready bundle by 2026-07-30 with a small set of constraints. Here's what I propose we include in the initial package:

1) Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (control-level index + executive summary) — attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-05.pdf
2) Pen test executive summary (full technical report restricted; executive summary attached) — attached: pen_test_summary_2026-06.pdf
3) Draft DPA for review (we can route for signature once CloudCore confirms acceptance) — attached: Redwood_DPA_Draft_2026-07.docx
4) 1-page controls summary (KM, retention, encryption-in-transit/at-rest) — included inline below and as a short PDF if you prefer

Constraints / notes:
- Legal has asked that the full SOC 2 report only be shared after a signed DPA or on a secure portal with account-level access; we can provide the executive summary to attach to the public listing.
- Pen test raw findings are restricted; the executive summary is acceptable for marketplace review per our policy.
- If CloudCore needs the full reports for co-sell due diligence, we'll require a DocuSign execution of the DPA or a secure transfer link (SFTP/Drive) with an approval ticket.

Planned timeline: we will share the initial bundle (redacted SOC2 + pen summary + DPA draft + 1-pager) by EOD 2026-07-27, which gives your team a few days to sign or request full reports.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-05.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)]
- [Attachment: pen_test_summary_2026-06.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]
- [Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Draft_2026-07.docx (DOCX, 85KB)]

If that timeline works I will loop in Legal (Laura) to confirm redaction level and add the DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Packaging requirements for marketplace listing

Folks — quick legal guidance to keep us consistent across marketplace programs:

- Provide SOC 2 executive summary publicly. The full SOC 2 Type II report can only be shared after an executed DPA or via our secure evidence portal (we prefer the portal route for joint customer diligence).
- Pen test executive summaries are shareable for marketplace attachments. Do not include raw test cases, IP, or PII from findings. Redact hostnames and internal IPs.
- The DPA draft attached by Sean is our standard template. We should request execution via DocuSign; if CloudCore requires edits, route them through me rather than exchanging multiple redlines in email.
- Add a short custody note: reports are gated for 12 months; if CloudCore requests archives older than 12 months, we will evaluate on a case-by-case basis.

Action items for Sean/Priyom: prepare the redacted SOC2 PDF and pen-test executive summary, attach the DPA DocuSign link in reply, and include a 1-page controls summary with "KM" (key management) section and the retention statement below. I will review the final bundle before sending externally.

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Data Protection | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudcore.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging requirements for marketplace listing

Thanks Sean and Laura — that approach works. Please send the initial bundle and the DocuSign link for the DPA as soon as you have it. Our internal catalog deadline is 2026-07-30 COB; if we have the executive summaries and DPA draft before then we can proceed with the listing intake and request full reports only for co-sell approvals.

Also: for DocuSign flows, please send the envelope to marketplace@cloudcore.com and cc me. If you can include the HubSpot deal id in the envelope notes (CCS-2026-089) that helps our procurement team match records.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to the bundle.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Partner Programs, CloudCore Systems
